basic_profile.bio: An avid gamer and lore enthusiast, FaithfulSunbro has been a dedicated member of the Reddit community for over seven years. Residing in the scenic landscapes of Oregon, USA, they spend their evenings delving into the intricate world of Dark Souls and other RPGs. By day, they work as a freelance writer, often contributing to gaming blogs and forums. When not battling virtual dragons, they enjoy exploring economic theories and the subtle intricacies of architecture, which is reflected in their frequent visits to subreddits like 'austrian_economics' and 'AmateurRoomPorn'. A night owl by nature, they are often online during late-night hours, sharing strategies and engaging with fellow gamers. Currently single, they find solace in the online communities that share their passions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: FaithfulSunbro has a deep understanding of video game mechanics, particularly in RPGs like Dark Souls 3. This expertise is largely self-taught, honed through countless hours of gameplay and participation in online forums. Additionally, their academic background in economics provides them with a unique perspective on game economies and player interactions.
